description:
Boundary case not asserted: when a failing step produces BOTH streams empty, the filter+join yields detail === ''. The test at :114-118 sets up exactly that input but asserts only calls.length, never the resulting detail. An explicit expect(result.detail).toBe('') would pin the empty-detail contract that truncatePreflightDetail then renders.
